title: Evaluating Assistive Technologies on a Trade Fair: Methodological Overview and Lessons Learned
reasoning: The paper focuses on the methodology of conducting user-centered evaluations for assistive technologies (specifically robotic arms for wheelchairs) at trade fairs. While it includes a standard discussion of ethical considerations regarding human subjects research (such as privacy and participant exhaustion), it does not involve the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
